{{RV|type=command

|version1= 0.76

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Adds magazine to a unit regardless of locality. This command can also be used to add magazine to a vehicle, like a static gun, for example.

|mp= Before {{arma3}} v2.00 this command was broken in MP and duplicated items per the number of clients.

|s1= unit [[addMagazineGlobal]] magazineName

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|p2= magazineName: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>player addMagazineGlobal "30Rnd_65x39_caseless_mag";</sqf>
